answer: SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

WITH cust_consumption AS (SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment), min_per_segment AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption FROM cust_consumption GROUP BY Segment), segment_avg AS (SELECT cc.Segment, mp.min_consumption * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM cust_consumption cc JOIN min_per_segment mp ON cc.Segment = mp.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mp.min_consumption GROUP BY cc.Segment, mp.min_consumption) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment='SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='CZK') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='EUR') AS diff;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency='EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS pct FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.Date LIKE '2013-06%';
